reason: A is upfront about what's harder: it says plainly that the job means evening work and that no one is promised 9 to 5. It also gives firm dates and seniority-based shift choice, and treats severance as a respectable option, so as a long-serving teller I can trust it and decide. B leaves placeholder dates, puts the hours change gently, and ends on a hopeful note, so it reads more like spin and less like it was written for us.
